comparison_level: Complete 16 MiB RAM and all GPRs, SR, PR, and return PC compared against the retail SH-4 interpreter.
scope: The eight-byte routine at 0x8c04f698 loads the global address from a PC-relative literal, reads a signed word into R0, then zero-extends R0 in the RTS delay slot. Tests cover 16-bit sign boundaries, all RAM bytes, and varied CPU state.
limitations: Uses the project SH-4 interpreter rather than Dreamcast hardware or end-to-end gameplay.
The global field’s higher-level meaning remains unidentified.
